request: A new motion film for the LitGrok GitHub page, made again with lit-typographic-motion and set in Pretendard, more aesthetic. Assume you are a pro motion graphic designer and very enthusiastic.
pathReason: The film has to show drawn things: the block mark that starts unlit with one glowing dot, a rail that a spark travels, a status row that flips from idle to ignited, a handoff card that moves into a fresh terminal. Type alone cannot show them, so the visuals are authored as a page and captured frame by frame.
idea: The lime dot on the block mark is a spark that ignites the mark from a single typed line, then travels the whole job as it moves through four routes, lights a status row and is handed to the next terminal, until it comes home and relights the mark.
audience: Developers who already use Grok Build and are deciding whether to add a working method on top of it.
channel: The top of the LitGrok GitHub README, autoplaying muted as an animated preview, with the MP4 one click away and a Korean version on the Korean page.
formatReason: A README column and the MP4 link both show a landscape frame; the large mark, the four-word rail and the status row read best wide.

beats.purpose: Opening motif: one dot in the dark, then one typed line lights the mark
beats.onScreen: Frame one is a giant charcoal block mark, centered, with only its lime dot glowing and breathing. The mark eases to the right while the headline 한 줄로 시작하세요. rises through a mask on the left, a slim terminal pane types a slash litwork prompt, and when the line lands the dot flares and orange, cream and lime sweep outward across the mark, followed by the LIT IGNITED line in its orange to pink to cyan gradient.
beats.motion: A long quiet hold, a scale-and-slide hand-off of the mark, mask-up headline, steady typing with a caret, a radial ignition sweep that starts at the dot.
beats.sound: a slow rise under the typing that swells into the hand-off to the next beat

beats.purpose: Set piece one: four routes, one spark
beats.onScreen: The lit mark shrinks into the top-left corner and its dot leaves it as a lime spark. A thin rail draws across the frame with four nodes. The words 계획, 구현, 검증, 인계 stand above the nodes in large dim type. The spark lands on each node in turn and each word lights up cream, the current one orange.
beats.motion: Scale hand-off of the mark to the corner, an arc flight of the spark to the first node, then three eased hops with a soft trail; words light on arrival.
beats.sound: a hit on the cut, a soft pulse as each word lights, a rise into the next cut

beats.purpose: Set piece two: the status row
beats.onScreen: The words leave first and the rail then thickens into a wide rounded bar, so nothing crosses the words. The headline 켜진 것을 확인하세요. sits above it. Inside the bar the idle row reads LIT, grok, the model and the context in orange, then it flips upward into the active row: two drawn flames, LIT IGNITED and litwork in the orange to pink to cyan gradient, the model and the context.
beats.motion: Match cut from rail to bar, the spark is absorbed with one soft ring, the idle row wipes up and the active row rises into its place.
beats.sound: a hit on the cut, a bright accent on the flip

beats.onScreen: The bar folds into a large card at right with the rows Built, Checked and Remains, each with a drawn tick or dot. The headline 다음 할 일을 남기세요. sits at left with clear space under the corner mark. The spark leaves the card on an arc and wakes a fresh terminal pane under it, which types a short line that picks the work up.
beats.motion: Match cut from bar to card, staggered row draw-on, arc flight of the spark, the pane grows from the point where the spark lands and types.
beats.sound: a hit on the cut, a rise as the spark travels, a soft chord as the pane wakes

beats.purpose: Resolve: the spark comes home and the mark is lit for good
beats.onScreen: The card and the pane collapse into the spark, the corner mark grows back to the left of the frame unlit, the spark lands on its dot and the mark relights. At right the tagline Keep the work lit. rises through a mask with lit. in orange, Grok Build용 sits under it, and the install command sits in a slim pill at the bottom. Everything then holds still.
beats.motion: Scale hand-off of the mark from the corner, an arc flight of the spark to the dot, a radial relight, mask-up tagline, a long readable hold.
beats.sound: a hit on the cut, then a closing cadence that rings out over the hold

subject.name: LitGrok
specifics: Adds a plan, build, verify and hand-off way of working to Grok Build sessions through skills, a project rule and hooks that live in the project's .grok folder.
Each step is a typed route (plan, build, verify, hand off), and an activated reply opens with the LIT IGNITED line.

An optional status row shows LIT and the model and context until a prompt starts a skill, then LIT IGNITED with the skill name; a handoff file lets the next session pick up the checked result and the next step.
Its block mark carries one lime dot, and the film treats that dot as the spark that moves through the work.

typePlan.hierarchy: Pretendard 700 for every headline and the four route words, with one orange accent phrase each; Pretendard 400 for the small line under the tagline; MesloLGS NF only for what a terminal prints. Hierarchy comes from size, colour, position and motion. No other weight is requested and nothing is tracked or condensed while it moves. Korean lines are set in the same two weights with no tracking or width change while they move.

palette.role: ground, near-black shared with the cover
type and the cream of the armor
the accent: the lit state and the orange of the mark
the lime dot, the spark and the checks
middle stop of the status-row gradient only

sound.plan: A slow, warm bed with soft keys, a rise under the first typed line, a hit on each of the four cuts and a resolving cadence over the last hold.

inventions: The copy lines, written from the README's own wording for the routes, the status row and the handoff.
The sample prompt, the card rows and the second terminal's line are illustrations built from strings the README, the hooks and the skills print or suggest.
The drawn flames stand in for the flame emoji, and the spark that travels the film is the mark's lime dot given a life of its own.
The Korean copy lines are written for the Korean page and follow the English film beat for beat; the tagline stays in English as the product's own line.
ambition: A quiet, large-type reel where one object runs the film: the lime dot of the mark leaves the mark, hops four routes, is absorbed into a status bar, is carried by a handoff card into a new terminal and comes home to relight the mark. Every cut is a match cut or a scale hand-off (mark to corner, rail to bar, bar to card, card to pane, corner to mark) with one accent phrase per headline, deliberate ease, long whitespace and a first frame that is already a poster.
